description: A collection of platform-independent Pure Data abstractions for processing lists. Its objects include operations for dripping, indexing, inserting, deleting, replacing, reversing, and comparing list elements.

research.notes: The official historical Pure Data SourceForge project hosts the maintained release and README, while Deken documentation confirms the package identity. No distinct source-code repository or library-specific tracker was verified, so the official project release location is supplied.
